_doc: TENANT-REPO-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22: "This is an app, a tenant, so it needs its own repo."): every tenant app lives in its own repository of the org; this repository keeps only its manifest (IDEA.md, instance.json, lifecycle.json, runway.json, README pointer). Read by foundation/tenantrepos.py (--check in checks) and by .github/workflows/tenant-repos.yml, which creates a missing repository from the tenant's folder with its history. The tenant's Worker is deployed by deploy-ultrastable, which builds it from the tenant repository named as `source` in doctrine/topology.json.

practical-solutions.why: created as its own repository from the start

unlearn.description: Unlearn: popular beliefs and famous findings set against the evidence. A tenant system running on Ultrastable.
